newsitem.title: USA: DepoTech in marketing pact with P&U.
newsitem.headline: DepoTech in marketing pact with P&U.

text.p: DepoTech Corp said Monday it signed an agreement with Pharmacia & Upjohn S.p.A, an affiliate of Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc, to market and distribute its anticancer agent DepoCyt outside the United States.

DepoTech said it will receive an undisclosed share of the net sales of DepoCyt by Pharmacia & Upjohn. Also, Pharmacia & Upjohn will pay DepoTech up to $19 million as an initial cash payment and additional payments after reaching certain regulatory milestones.
The company said DepoCyt is an injectable, sustained-release formulation of the chemotherapeutic agent cytarabine for patients with neoplastic meningitis, lymphoma and leukemia.

DepoTech, which will maintain manufacturing rights to the DepoCyt formulation, also said it recently repurchased the rights to DepoCyt in Canada and Europe from Chiron Corp which retains U.S. marketing rights to the agent.
